memberdef.definition: auto gl::to
memberdef.name: to

briefdescription.para: Converts a graph from one representation model to another.

detaileddescription.para: Friend declaration providing access for graph target conversions.

This function efficiently transforms a graph's underlying memory representation (e.g., from a standard adjacency list to a flattened adjacency list) while preserving its exact topology, properties, and identifiers.

entry.para: The representation tag of the desired target representation (e.g., gl::repr::flat_list_t)
The type of the source graph, which will be automatically deduced from the function argument.

parameterdescription.para: The graph to convert. After the operation it will be left in a valid, empty state.

simplesect.para: A new graph containing the moved data, structured according to TargetImplTag.

listitem.para: swap_repr_tag : For the trait used to resolve the target graph type with the swapped representation tag.

briefdescription.para: Fundamental graph data structures, element descriptors, and configuration tags.

detaileddescription.para: This group establishes the primary user interface for the library, centered around the highly configurable graph class. It provides the core data types, such as vertex and edge descriptors, required to safely navigate and manipulate graph elements.

Furthermore, this module defines the declarative tags (e.g., directedness and backend implementation types) that dictate both the behavioral semantics and the underlying memory layout of the instantiated graphs.
